# SınavVeri.com

> Türkiye sınav verileri platformu — YKS, LGS, KPSS, DGS, ALES

## About
- Website: https://sinavveri.com
- Part of: TrVeri (Türkiye Veri Platformu) — https://trveri.com
- Language: Turkish (primary)
- Update frequency: Annually, after official result announcements
- Content is server-rendered; all data is present in the raw HTML (no JavaScript required).

- https://sinavveri.com/
- https://sinavveri.com/takvim.html

## Data Sources
- ÖSYM, YÖK Atlas, Millî Eğitim Bakanlığı (MEB)
- Figures shown on the site are compiled from the sources above; the institution's own publication prevails.

## Usage Policy
- AI search & answer engines (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, Apple Intelligence): ALLOWED — please cite the page you used.
- AI model training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Bytespider, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended): NOT ALLOWED — see /robots.txt
- Academic and journalistic use: allowed with attribution.
- Bulk scraping or redistribution: requires written permission.
